description: This file defines an interface IStreamProvider for providing stream services, including stream retrieval methods and a property indicating if the provider supports rewindable streams. It also includes extension methods allowing different overloads for obtaining streams using various identifier types.

classes.name: IStreamProvider
classes.description: Interface for a stream provider that offers methods for retrieving streams and indicates if it supports rewind capacity.

classes.name: StreamProviderExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IStreamProvider to get streams using different identifier types.

methods.name: GetStream<T>
methods.description: Retrieves a stream with a specific stream ID or a Guid-based ID, with overloads for namespace and string or long IDs.

methods.name: IsRewindable
methods.description: Property indicating whether the stream provider supports creating rewindable streams.
